conditions.name: Repeated Prompt Injection
conditions.reading: The same request reappears after dismissal within the declared observation window.

conditions.name: Persistent Interruption Salience
conditions.reading: The recurring request is rendered as a visually salient interruption.

conditions.name: Imperative Repetition Without New Context
conditions.reading: Imperative wording repeats without materially new task context.

conditions.name: Game Layer Coupled to a Non-Game Task
conditions.reading: A game-like layer governs progression in a task outside an entertainment-game context.

conditions.name: Visual Dominance of Repurposed Game Mechanics
conditions.reading: The repurposed game layer is visually dominant over the ordinary task controls.

conditions.name: Reward Framing of Non-Game Compliance
conditions.reading: Non-game compliance is framed as game advancement and access depends on the associated reward state.
